cues.en: This is the Global News podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是 BBC World Service《全球新闻》播客。

cues.en: I'm Alex Ritson, and in the early hours of Tuesday, 15 September, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 我是亚历克斯·里特森。9月15日星期二凌晨，以下是我们的主要新闻。

cues.en: Police in Turkey fire tear gas at protesters following a crackdown on gay bars and LGBTQ activists.
cues.zh: 土耳其警方在打击同性恋酒吧和 LGBTQ 活动人士后，向抗议者发射催泪瓦斯。

cues.en: Also in this podcast: more than 60% died, but now it's less than 30%.
cues.zh: 本期节目还将讲述：过去死亡率超过60%，如今已低于30%。

cues.en: It's one of the most dramatic stories in all of medicine: winning the fight against breast cancer over the last 50 years.
cues.zh: 这是医学领域最具戏剧性的故事之一：过去50年来，人们如何赢得抗击乳腺癌之战。

cues.en: To Turkey, where police have fired tear gas at protesters in the western city of Izmir.
cues.zh: 转到土耳其：警方在西部城市伊兹密尔向抗议者发射催泪瓦斯。

cues.en: The demonstrators, chanting slogans such as 'Hate kills, not love,'...
cues.zh: 示威者高喊“仇恨致命，爱不会”之类的口号……

cues.en: ...were marching against the increasing targeting of the LGBTQ community in Turkey.
cues.zh: ……他们游行抗议土耳其对LGBTQ群体日益加剧的打压。

cues.en: On Sunday, dozens were arrested in nationwide raids on gay bars and private homes.
cues.zh: 周日，全国范围内突袭同性恋酒吧和私人住宅，数十人被捕。

cues.en: A court has suspended the social media accounts of human rights groups, journalists and campaigners, citing national security concerns.
cues.zh: 法院以国家安全为由，暂停了人权团体、记者和活动人士的社交媒体账号。

cues.en: Our correspondent in Istanbul, Orla Guerin, has more.
cues.zh: 我们驻伊斯坦布尔记者奥拉·格林带来更多报道。

cues.en: Step by step, Turkey is cracking down harder on familiar targets.
cues.zh: 土耳其正逐步加大对老目标的打压力度。

cues.en: First, police raids and arrests. Now, the blocking of social media accounts.
cues.zh: 先是警方突袭和逮捕，如今又封锁社交媒体账号。

cues.en: Amnesty's director in Turkey told the BBC this was a first for the organisation and said it was very concerning.
cues.zh: 国际特赦组织土耳其主任告诉BBC，这是该组织首次遇到这种情况，并称其令人非常担忧。

cues.en: But she added, 'It's not just us; it's part of a broader operation.'
cues.zh: 但她补充说：“不只是我们，这是更大范围行动的一部分。”

cues.en: Turkey says it is protecting family values and social order.
cues.zh: 土耳其称此举是在保护家庭价值观和社会秩序。

cues.en: Human rights activists say the state is intensifying a campaign of discrimination.
cues.zh: 人权活动人士称，国家正在加剧一场歧视行动。

cues.en: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan has blamed LGBTQ people for the country's falling birth rate and called them perverts.
cues.zh: 雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安总统将该国出生率下降归咎于LGBTQ群体，并称他们是变态。

cues.en: Pride parades have been banned since 2015.
cues.zh: 骄傲游行自2015年以来一直被禁止。

cues.en: Critics see the authorities' latest moves as an attack on human rights and free speech.
cues.zh: 批评者认为，当局的最新举措是在侵犯人权和言论自由。

cues.en: The European Parliament's rapporteur on Turkey said the arrests were a shocking escalation of repression.
cues.zh: 欧洲议会土耳其问题报告员称，这些逮捕行动标志着镇压惊人升级。

cues.en: Orla Guerin in Istanbul.
cues.zh: 奥拉·格林，伊斯坦布尔。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast:
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后还有：

cues.en: Lately, we've taken huge steps forward in female athletes being taken seriously, but this feels like a big step backwards.
cues.zh: 近来，女性运动员受到认真对待方面已有巨大进步，但这感觉像是大幅倒退。

cues.en: The Sydney Sweeney advert that's caused an uproar in women's sport.
cues.zh: 西德妮·斯威尼的广告在女子体育界引发轩然大波。

cues.en: This is the Global News podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻》播客。

cues.en: The US Environmental Protection Agency, the EPA, is scrapping limits on emissions from coal- and gas-fired power plants.
cues.zh: 美国环境保护署（EPA）正取消对燃煤和燃气发电厂排放的限制。

cues.en: The move is expected to face immediate legal challenges. Environmental groups say removing the rules will badly harm Americans' health and the planet.
cues.zh: 这项举措预计将立即面临法律挑战。环保团体称，取消这些规定将严重损害美国民众的健康和地球环境。

cues.en: Samira Hussein reports.
cues.zh: 萨米拉·侯赛因报道。

cues.en: President Trump has called man-made climate change the greatest con job ever perpetrated on the world.
cues.zh: 特朗普总统称，人为气候变化是有史以来对全世界实施的最大骗局。

cues.en: His administration has long signalled that it wants to scrap restrictions imposed by his predecessors.
cues.zh: 他的政府早已表明，想要废除前任政府设下的限制。

cues.en: Those limits govern how much greenhouse gas coal- and natural-gas-fired power stations can emit.
cues.zh: 这些限制规定了燃煤和天然气发电站可以排放多少温室气体。

cues.en: EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin announced the rule change.
cues.zh: 美国环保署署长李·泽尔丁宣布了这项规则变更。

cues.en: It will allow power producers to put many more of the gases that cause global warming into the atmosphere.
cues.zh: 这将允许发电行业向大气中排放更多导致全球变暖的气体。

cues.en: “Today, we're repealing the majority of the burdensome 24 requirements so Americans can benefit from our nation's full energy potential.”
cues.zh: “今天，我们将废除24项繁重要求中的大部分，让美国民众受益于国家全部的能源潜力。”

cues.en: “We're not just stopping the Biden administration's overreach.”
cues.zh: “我们不只是要制止拜登政府的越权行为。”

cues.en: “We're also proposing to rescind all remaining greenhouse-gas emissions standards for power plants—all of them.”
cues.zh: “我们还提议废除所有剩余的发电厂温室气体排放标准，一个不留。”

cues.en: “The reality is that America produces energy better and cleaner than anywhere else in the world.”
cues.zh: “事实是，美国的能源生产比世界其他任何地方都更好、更清洁。”

cues.en: The power-generating sector is already America's second-largest source of greenhouse gases, after transportation.
cues.zh: 在美国，发电行业已经是温室气体的第二大来源，仅次于交通运输。

cues.en: Mr Zeldin says his changes will save the industry more than $300 billion.
cues.zh: 泽尔丁先生称，这些变更将为该行业节省超过3000亿美元。

cues.en: “It's a different day under President Trump.”
cues.zh: “特朗普总统执政，时代已经不同了。”

cues.en: “Previous administrations sought overbearing, often unlawful rules to destroy reliable baseload power.”
cues.zh: “前几届政府试图用专横且往往违法的规则摧毁可靠的基荷电力。”

cues.en: “They made energy prices skyrocket and threatened communities and states across the country.”
cues.zh: “这些规则推高了能源价格，也威胁到全国各地的社区和州。”

cues.en: This comes as rapid data-centre construction has created huge new demand for electricity.
cues.zh: 与此同时，数据中心迅速建设，带来了巨大的新增用电需求。

cues.en: Our business correspondent, Samira Hussein, in New York.
cues.zh: 本台驻纽约商业记者萨米拉·侯赛因报道。

cues.en: Prince Harry, King Charles's youngest son, has just moved back to the UK with his family.
cues.zh: 查尔斯国王的小儿子哈里王子刚刚和家人搬回英国。

cues.en: But now it has emerged that Harry and his wife Meghan changed their children's school just days after they started, over security concerns about Archie and Lilibet's school run.
cues.zh: 但如今有消息称，哈里和妻子梅根因担心阿奇和莉莉贝特上学途中的安全，在孩子入学几天后就为他们换了学校。

cues.en: A big question after the family's return to Britain is: who should pay for the Sussexes' security?
cues.zh: 一家人返回英国后，一个重大问题是：谁该为萨塞克斯夫妇的安保买单？

cues.en: Their status was downgraded six years ago after they stepped back from being working royals.
cues.zh: 六年前，他们退出王室公务后，安保级别随之下调。

cues.en: But their publicly funded protection is understood to be under review now that they and their two children live in the UK full-time.
cues.zh: 不过，据了解，既然他们和两个孩子已在英国长期居住，公费安保将接受重新审查。

cues.en: I asked our royal correspondent Sean Coughlan why their security had become such a talked-about subject in Britain.
cues.zh: 我问了本台王室事务记者肖恩·考夫兰，为什么他们的安保在英国成了热门话题。

cues.en: Well, in the past it was controversial when they lived in California, particularly for Prince Harry.
cues.zh: 过去，他们住在加利福尼亚时，这件事颇有争议，尤其是对哈里王子而言。

cues.en: He was particularly upset that, on returning to the UK, he didn't have the level of security he felt he should have.
cues.zh: 他尤其不满的是，回到英国后，他没有得到自己认为理应享有的安保级别。

cues.en: He thought the risks hadn't really changed.
cues.zh: 他认为，风险其实并没有改变。

cues.en: He was still a member of the royal family, still the son of the king.
cues.zh: 他仍是王室成员，仍然是国王的儿子。

cues.en: What's changed is that they're now full-time residents of the UK.
cues.zh: 如今的变化是，他们现在长期居住在英国。

cues.en: Arrangements that used to cover occasional trips have changed.
cues.zh: 过去针对偶尔出行的安排也发生了变化。

cues.en: A committee considers these matters; it's known as RAVEC.
cues.zh: 有个委员会负责审议这些事项，名为 RAVEC。

cues.en: It's the Executive Committee for the Protection of Royalty and Public Figures, which decides what protection royalty or VIPs should receive.
cues.zh: 它是王室及公众人物保护执行委员会，负责决定王室成员或贵宾应获得何种公共保护。

cues.en: It now seems the committee has met and wants to reconsider the security given to Prince Harry, Meghan and their children.
cues.zh: 目前看来，委员会已经开会，并希望重新考虑哈里王子、梅根及其子女应获的安保级别。

cues.en: Their circumstances have changed, so a review is under way to consider whether their security should change too.
cues.zh: 他们的情况已经改变，因此正在审查安保是否也应随之调整。

cues.en: They're not proposing to pay for it themselves, are they?
cues.zh: 他们并不打算自己出钱，对吧？

cues.en: They want the British taxpayer to fund it.
cues.zh: 他们希望由英国纳税人出资。

cues.en: That would be public funding, perhaps alongside their own private security; we don't know.
cues.zh: 那将是公共资金，也可能是在他们自己的私人安保之外另行提供；我们并不清楚。

cues.en: As is usual in such cases, security levels are always confidential.
cues.zh: 像这类情况通常一样，安保级别始终是保密的。

cues.en: The Home Office will never say exactly what protection was provided or what risks it relates to.
cues.zh: 英国内政部绝不会具体说明提供了什么保护，或相关风险是什么。

cues.en: So it all sits under a cloud of confidentiality.
cues.zh: 所以这一切都笼罩在保密之中。

cues.en: Their security is in the news for more than one reason.
cues.zh: 他们的安保问题不止一个方面登上了新闻。

cues.en: Their children briefly attended school in the UK, then had to move to another school over security concerns.
cues.zh: 他们的孩子曾短暂在英国上学，后来因安保顾虑不得不转到另一所学校。

cues.en: Yes, that's a rather strange twist in the story we've heard this evening.
cues.zh: 是的，这给我们今晚听到的故事添了一个相当奇怪的转折。

cues.en: The children had started a new school after moving from the US to the UK.
cues.zh: 孩子们从美国搬到英国后，已经开始在一所新学校上学。

cues.en: They'd gone through the difficult experience of starting at a new school.
cues.zh: 他们经历了转学、重新开始上学的艰难过程。

cues.en: That's always tough for any family, and for any child.
cues.zh: 这对任何家庭、任何孩子来说都不容易。

cues.en: They'd only been there a couple of days when it was decided they'd have to move school again.
cues.zh: 他们在那里才上了几天学，就决定必须再次转学。

cues.en: And the thinking behind it, it seems, is that their private security team worried the school run might not be secure enough,
cues.zh: 而他们这么决定的原因似乎是，私人安保团队担心无法确保孩子上学路上的安全，

cues.en: and there seemed to be specific worries about heavy traffic on the school run and the distance they had to travel.
cues.zh: 尤其担心上学路上交通繁忙，以及他们需要走多远。

cues.en: We don't know exactly which school it is,
cues.zh: 我们不知道具体是哪所学校，

cues.en: or how far the children had to travel, but this was enough to worry their security advisers,
cues.zh: 也不知道孩子们要走多远；但这足以让他们的安保顾问担忧，

cues.en: who thought the journey wasn't safe, so the children will now go to another school.
cues.zh: 顾问认为这段路不安全，因此孩子们现在要转去另一所学校。

cues.en: It does feel, Sean, that there are real tensions between Harry and Meghan and the royal family, or the Firm, since their return to the UK.
cues.zh: 肖恩，他们回到英国后，哈里和梅根与王室——也就是人们常说的“王室机构”——之间似乎确实存在紧张关系。

cues.en: Well, I think that's right. Questions about security are part of a wider swirl of questions about what their role is.
cues.zh: 嗯，我认为确实如此。安保问题只是围绕他们定位的一系列疑问之一。

cues.en: They'll soon appear at major public events, and many people will see these as royal occasions.
cues.zh: 他们很快会出席大型公共活动，很多人会把这些场合看作王室活动。

cues.en: They'll be waving, smiling, having photographs taken, and treated a bit like a royal visit.
cues.zh: 他们会挥手、微笑、合影，受到的对待也有点像王室出访。

cues.en: But Buckingham Palace will say that's completely wrong.
cues.zh: 但白金汉宫会说，这种看法完全错了。

cues.en: These are just people carrying out events like celebrities, and I think there's a kind of tension there.
cues.zh: 他们不过是像名人一样参加活动；我认为这其中存在某种紧张关系。

cues.en: There's possibly a battle for media attention, and a battle for public opinion as well.
cues.zh: 这可能既是一场争夺媒体关注的较量，也是一场争取公众舆论的较量。

cues.en: I think these things will play out this autumn.
cues.zh: 我认为这些事会在今年秋天继续发展。

cues.en: They've been away a long time; their return is like a soap opera, you know.
cues.zh: 他们离开了很久。你知道，他们这次回来有点像肥皂剧的剧情。

cues.en: The character who left has turned up again, and that always means conflict. Sean Coughlan.
cues.zh: 离开的角色再次登场，这总意味着冲突。肖恩·考夫兰。

cues.en: A breast cancer diagnosis was once regarded as a death sentence.
cues.zh: 乳腺癌曾一度被视为绝症判决。

cues.en: But over the past 50 years, treatment and outcomes have been transformed.
cues.zh: 但过去50年来，治疗手段和治疗效果已发生巨大变化。

cues.en: Professor Ian Smith, an oncologist and a world-leading expert on the disease,
cues.zh: 肿瘤科医生、该疾病领域的世界顶尖专家伊恩·史密斯教授，

cues.en: has just published a book, Doctor I Found a Lump, which he calls the pioneering story of breast cancer medicine.
cues.zh: 刚出版了《医生，我发现了肿块》一书，他称这本书讲述了乳腺癌医学的开创历程。

cues.en: A former patient, Debbie McMenamin, and Professor Smith have been speaking to the BBC about their experiences.
cues.zh: 曾接受治疗的患者黛比·麦克梅纳明和史密斯教授向 BBC 讲述了他们的经历。

cues.en: When I began, more than 60% of patients died of breast cancer—the majority.
cues.zh: 我刚入行时，超过60%的乳腺癌患者会死亡，占了大多数。

cues.en: But now it's less than 30%.
cues.zh: 如今这个比例不到30%。

cues.en: It's one of the most dramatic stories in all of medicine, I think.
cues.zh: 我认为，这是整个医学领域最显著的进步之一。

cues.en: I think the key was what we didn't realize.
cues.zh: 我认为，关键在于我们过去没有意识到这一点。

cues.en: Microscopic cancer cells develop very early in breast cancer.
cues.zh: 乳腺癌的微小癌细胞很早就会形成。

cues.en: By the time a patient comes to hospital with a lump, those microscopic cancer cells have often spread.
cues.zh: 患者发现肿块、来到医院时，这些微小癌细胞往往已经扩散。

cues.en: So it doesn't matter how skillful the surgeon is; it's too late.
cues.zh: 所以，无论外科医生技术多么高超，都已经太迟了。

cues.en: Once we understood this, we began giving treatment after surgery to kill those cells off,
cues.zh: 明白这一点后，我们开始在手术后给予治疗，以杀灭这些癌细胞，

cues.en: what we call adjuvant medical therapy. That was the biggest transformation.
cues.zh: 这就是所谓的辅助药物治疗，也是最大的变革。

cues.en: Debbie, can I bring you in? You went to Professor Smith and said, 'Doctor, I found a lump.'
cues.zh: 黛比，我来问问你。你曾去找史密斯教授，说：“医生，我发现了一个肿块。”

cues.en: The lump was diagnosed as an aggressive form of breast cancer.
cues.zh: 肿块被确诊为一种侵袭性乳腺癌。

cues.en: I was advised to have chemotherapy, radiotherapy and five years of endocrine therapy, tamoxifen.
cues.zh: 我被建议接受化疗、放疗，以及为期五年的内分泌治疗——他莫昔芬。

cues.en: I benefited from real-time research and was prescribed tamoxifen for five years.
cues.zh: 我也受益于实时推进的研究，并接受了五年的他莫昔芬治疗。

cues.en: At the end of those five years, I learned that research conducted during that first five-year period...
cues.zh: 五年疗程结束时，我得知在那前五年进行的研究……

cues.en: showed that people like me would benefit from taking it for ten years.
cues.zh: 显示像我这样的人服用十年会更有益。

cues.en: So I was very conscious that I was benefiting from the research.
cues.zh: 所以我很清楚，自己正受益于这项研究。

cues.en: One of the best pieces of advice Ian gave me was,
cues.zh: 伊恩给过我的最好建议之一是：

cues.en: 'Don't look at the packet or read the side effects, because most people don't have any.'
cues.zh: “别看药盒，也别读副作用说明，因为大多数人都不会出现副作用。”

cues.en: There have been major advances in screening, but is there a risk of overdiagnosis?
cues.zh: 筛查已取得重大进展，但会不会有过度诊断的风险？

cues.en: Breast cancer screening is very controversial; in my view, it has never convincingly been shown to save lives.
cues.zh: 乳腺癌筛查颇具争议；在我看来，它从未被令人信服地证明能够挽救生命。

cues.en: The improvement in survival is just as high in younger women, who were never screened, as in older women.
cues.zh: 年轻女性即使从未接受筛查，生存率的改善也和年长女性一样显著。

cues.en: Early detection is very important. If a woman finds a lump, what next steps excite you?
cues.zh: 早期发现非常重要。如果女性发现肿块，接下来有哪些进展让你感到振奋？

cues.en: We now have the technology to identify the specific gene mutations in a cancer.
cues.zh: 如今我们已有技术，可以识别癌症中的特定基因突变。

cues.en: You can design a drug to target the mutation and switch it off.
cues.zh: 我们可以设计药物，针对这种突变并将其关闭。

cues.en: So we're now in an era of targeted therapy.
cues.zh: 因此，我们现在进入了靶向治疗时代。

cues.en: And another thing is liquid biopsies.
cues.zh: 另一个进展是液体活检。

cues.en: In the past, we couldn't detect these microscopic cells.
cues.zh: 过去，我们无法检测这些微小细胞。

cues.en: Now we can detect tiny bits of DNA—the cancer's genetic material—in the bloodstream.
cues.zh: 现在，我们能在血液中检测到微量 DNA，也就是癌症的遗传物质。

cues.en: If it's there, it means the patient needs treatment to get rid of it.
cues.zh: 如果检测到这些 DNA，就意味着患者需要治疗来清除它。

cues.en: And if you start treatment and the DNA goes away, that shows the treatment is working.
cues.zh: 如果开始治疗后 DNA 消失，就说明治疗正在起效。

cues.en: So we'll be much more confident that an individual patient is on the right drug.
cues.zh: 这样，我们就能更有把握地确认每位患者用对了药。

cues.en: And Debbie, the fundraising you've been involved in suggests that you're fully recovered.
cues.zh: 黛比，你参与筹款活动，这似乎说明你已经完全康复。

cues.en: Through Ian, I've got involved in a big cycling event.
cues.zh: 通过伊恩，我参与了一项大型骑行活动。

cues.en: We go to the Alps and cycle for four days up mountains.
cues.zh: 我们去阿尔卑斯山区，连续四天骑车爬山。

cues.en: We aim to climb an elevation equal to the height of Everest on our bikes.
cues.zh: 我们骑车爬升的海拔总高度，要相当于珠穆朗玛峰的高度。

cues.en: It's very arduous, but great fun.
cues.zh: 这非常艰苦，但也很有趣。

cues.en: But it suggests that you're in good shape.
cues.zh: 但这说明你的身体状况很好。

cues.en: Well, to an extent. But I have to say, having just read the book last night,
cues.zh: 嗯，在某种程度上是。但我得说，我昨晚刚读完这本书，

cues.en: Ian talks about how exercise reduces the risk of recurrence by up to 40%.
cues.zh: 伊恩提到，运动最多能将癌症复发风险降低40%。

cues.en: So, dare I say it, any fit and healthy post-treatment breast cancer patient should do this with us, because it's good for them and for research.
cues.zh: 所以我敢说，任何身体健康、完成乳腺癌治疗的患者都该和我们一起参加，这对他们和研究都有好处。

cues.en: Breast cancer survivor Debbie McMenamin and British oncologist Professor Ian Smith speaking to Tim Franks.
cues.zh: 乳腺癌康复者黛比·麦克梅纳明和英国肿瘤科医生伊恩·史密斯教授接受了蒂姆·弗兰克斯采访。

cues.en: US actress Sydney Sweeney has a history of controversial marketing campaigns, selling soap infused with her own bathwater.
cues.zh: 美国女演员西德妮·斯威尼曾有过颇具争议的营销活动，比如出售浸有她本人洗澡水的肥皂。

cues.en: She also posed in a jeans advert that hinted at eugenics.
cues.zh: 她还为一则牛仔裤广告摆拍，该广告暗示了优生学。

cues.en: Her latest ad, promoting a betting app, is ruffling feathers in sport after showing her in highly revealing poses.
cues.zh: 她最新的一则博彩应用广告因展示她穿着暴露的姿势，在体育界引发争议。

cues.en: Dozens of female athletes say it objectifies women in sport. Helena Burke has the story.
cues.zh: 数十名女运动员称，该广告把女性体育运动员物化了。海伦娜·伯克报道。

cues.en: This Novig sports betting ad shows Sydney Sweeney completely naked, with sports equipment strategically covering certain parts of her body.
cues.zh: 这则 Novig 体育博彩广告中，西德妮·斯威尼全裸出镜，用运动器材巧妙遮住身体的部分部位。

cues.en: Since it was posted on Instagram last week, the video has received nearly 40 million views.
cues.zh: 这段视频上周发布到 Instagram 后，浏览量已接近4,000万。

cues.en: But not everyone is a fan.
cues.zh: 但并非所有人都喜欢这则广告。

cues.en: A string of athletes have criticised the video, saying it sets women's sport back by framing female athletes as sexual objects.
cues.zh: 许多运动员批评这段视频，称它把女运动员塑造成性对象，让女子体育倒退。

cues.en: After finishing her race at the World Athletics Ultimate Championship, British sprinter Amy Hunt joined the chorus.
cues.zh: 英国短跑运动员艾米·亨特在世界田径终极锦标赛完成比赛后，也加入了批评声浪。

cues.en: Sydney Sweeney, this is what women in sport look like: 21.4. Muscles, hard work, sweat, blood and tears.
cues.zh: 西德妮·斯威尼，这才是女性体育的样子：21.4秒。肌肉、努力、汗水、鲜血和泪水。

cues.en: In response to the ad, dozens of videos have been posted online by female athletes showing themselves training and competing.
cues.zh: 针对这则广告，数十名女运动员在网上发布了自己训练和比赛的视频。

cues.en: Olympic water polo player Tilly Kearns told the Australian Broadcasting Corporation
cues.zh: 奥运会水球运动员蒂莉·卡恩斯对澳大利亚广播公司表示，

cues.en: She believes the ad undermines progress in changing public perceptions of women's sport.
cues.zh: 她认为，这则广告损害了改变公众对女子体育看法的进展。

cues.en: It's something I, like most female athletes, spend my whole career trying to rebut: we're obviously much more than our bodies.
cues.zh: 这正是我和许多女运动员整个职业生涯都在努力反驳的观点：显然，我们远不只是自己的身体。

cues.en: Lately we've taken huge steps forward in female athletes being taken seriously, but this feels like a big step backwards.
cues.zh: 近来，女运动员获得了更多重视，这是巨大进步；但这件事让人觉得倒退了一大步。

cues.en: In recent years, a number of sports have relaxed uniform requirements for women, giving athletes more freedom over what they wear.
cues.zh: 近年来，许多运动放宽了女性的着装规定，让运动员在穿着上有更多自由。

cues.en: Female beach volleyball players may now wear shorts instead of bikini bottoms, while French gymnasts no longer have to wear high-cut leotards.
cues.zh: 女子沙滩排球选手现在可以穿短裤而非比基尼下装，法国体操运动员也不再被要求穿高叉紧身衣。

cues.en: Sydney Sweeney responded to the backlash by posting photos from ESPN magazine featuring athletes either naked or semi-nude.
cues.zh: 西德妮·斯威尼发布了 ESPN 杂志上运动员全裸或半裸的照片，以回应外界批评。

cues.en: But Tilly Kearns believes that's not a fair comparison.
cues.zh: 但蒂莉·卡恩斯认为，这样比较并不公平。

cues.en: She's posted the athletes, but they're posed for this magazine as athletes first,
cues.zh: 她发布了那些运动员的照片，但她们为这本杂志摆拍时，首先是以运动员的身份，

cues.en: and I think the way they're posed is: “Look at what my body can do for me in whatever sport it is.”
cues.zh: 我认为她们的姿势表达的是：“看看我的身体能在这项运动中做到什么。”

cues.en: And I think it's vastly different from her ad, where she was posed to say, “Look at my body,” instead of what it can do.
cues.zh: 我认为这与她的广告截然不同：她摆出的姿势像是在说“看我的身体”，而不是看它能做到什么。

cues.en: As the old saying goes, all publicity is good publicity.
cues.zh: 俗话说，所有宣传都是好宣传。

cues.en: Many people online have praised the ad,
cues.zh: 许多网友称赞这则广告，

cues.en: while others claim that the negative reaction is actually helping promote the brand.
cues.zh: 另一些人则称，负面反应反而在帮助这个品牌推广。

cues.en: Dr Cheri Bradish, a sports marketing expert from Toronto Metropolitan University, isn't convinced the backlash will help the betting app.
cues.zh: 多伦多都会大学体育营销专家谢丽·布拉迪什博士并不认为，这场反弹会帮助这款博彩应用。

cues.en: I think they'll realise in a post-mortem how this really didn't hit the mark,
cues.zh: 我认为，事后复盘时他们会意识到，这次推广确实没有达到预期，

cues.en: with so many key demographics and the women's sports marketplace in particular.
cues.zh: 尤其没有打动许多关键受众群体，以及女子体育市场。

cues.en: I do feel we have a healthier marketplace that's beginning in very sophisticated ways.
cues.zh: 我确实觉得，我们正迎来一个更健康的市场，开始以非常成熟的方式发展。

cues.en: It is addressing who the true female athlete is, and representing women in sport in a really healthy, accurate way.
cues.zh: 它正致力于呈现真正的女性运动员，并以健康、准确的方式展现体育中的女性。

cues.en: The BBC has contacted Sydney Sweeney and Novig for comment.
cues.zh: BBC 已联系西德妮·斯威尼和 Novig 征求回应。

cues.en: Helena Burke.
cues.zh: 海伦娜·伯克。

cues.en: And that's all from us for now.
cues.zh: 我们今天的节目就到这里。

cues.en: If you want to get in touch, you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 如果你想联系我们，可以发邮件至 globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: You can also find us on X at BBC World Service. Use the hashtag Global News Pod.
cues.zh: 你也可以在 X 上关注 BBC World Service，并使用话题标签 Global News Pod。

cues.en: And don't forget our sibling podcast, The Global Story, which goes in-depth and beyond the headlines on one big story.
cues.zh: 别忘了我们的姊妹播客《The Global Story》，它会围绕一个重大话题深入报道，超越新闻标题。

cues.en: This edition of The Global News Podcast was mixed by Darcy O'Bree, produced by Stephanie Zakreson, and edited by Karen Martin.
cues.zh: 本期《Global News Podcast》由达西·奥布里混音，斯蒂芬妮·扎克雷森制作，凯伦·马丁编辑。

cues.en: I'm Alex Ritson. Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 我是亚历克斯·里特森。下次再见。
